caseNameFull: Burns, Commissioner, Department of Social Services of Iowa v. Alcala

opinions.text: C. A. 8th Cir. [Certiorari granted, ante, p. 823.] Motion of American Association for Maternal & Child Health et al. for leave to file a brief as amici curiae granted. Motion of the Attorney General of Florida for leave to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae denied.
